executiveOverview: GOLDY Co., Ltd. is a Tokyo company founded in February 1990 that plans, designs, manufactures and wholesales fashion accessories and jewelry under the GOLDY brand. Through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), it is looking for international wholesale, retail and pop-up partners. Taiwan and South Korea are the first priority, followed by Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore. Suitable partners include fashion distributors, select shops, department stores, e-commerce operators and pop-up organizers.

sections.heading: The opportunity
paragraphs: GOLDY, a Tokyo fashion accessories and jewelry company, is seeking partners outside Japan for wholesale, retail and pop-up distribution of its collections. The first focus is Taiwan and South Korea, with Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore as further target markets.

The company is open to several formats rather than a single route: wholesale supply to retailers, placement through department stores and select shops, online sales through e-commerce businesses, and temporary pop-up stores run with a local partner.

sections.heading: About GOLDY Co., Ltd.
paragraphs: GOLDY Co., Ltd. (株式会社ゴールディ) was founded in February 1990 and is headquartered in Jingumae, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. Its registered business is the planning, design, manufacturing, wholesale, OEM and sale of accessories and fashion goods.

The company describes its aim as designing and manufacturing accessories and jewelry as the fashion item that allows the most self-expression, built on ideas and originality, and giving customers a sense of playfulness and enjoyment in dressing up. The GOLDY brand is aimed at women who enjoy their own fashion style in a playful way.

sections.heading: Products and brand
paragraphs: GOLDY works in fashion accessories and jewelry, including earrings, necklaces, rings and similar items. The official brand tagline is a call to lead fashion through design, and the company says it plans around monthly new items, additional production of popular designs and stocked standard items.

Its wholesale approach pairs design-led product planning with merchandising that takes the sales floor into account. Current collections, assortments and wholesale lines are shared on request, and the official online store is at goldy.jp.

sections.heading: Expansion plan
paragraphs: The introduced opportunity is structured around Taiwan and South Korea first, then Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore. The sequence and the scope of each market are set with qualified partners during discussion.

On its website GOLDY lists retail formats beyond ordinary wholesale, including pop-up stores, shops and brand corners, and it welcomes collaborative sales and product development proposals. These formats are relevant for partners wanting to test the brand in a limited-term or limited-space format first.

sections.heading: Who GOLDY wants to work with
paragraphs: Target partners are fashion distributors, select shops, department stores, e-commerce businesses and pop-up partners in the markets above. A strong candidate already sells women's accessories or fashion goods, has access to relevant retail floors or online channels in its market, and can describe its customer profile and sales approach in the first inquiry.
Partners should expect to be asked about their channels, locations, existing brand portfolio and planned order volumes, since GOLDY has not published fixed terms for overseas partners.

sections.heading: Considerations for partners
paragraphs: Pricing, minimum order quantities, payment terms, territory scope and any exclusivity are not published and are discussed only after a qualified inquiry. No territory should be assumed to be available or exclusive.

Importers remain responsible for customs classification, duties and local product-safety and labelling rules for jewelry and accessories in their own market, including any rules on metal content that apply there.

sections.heading: Why this opportunity
paragraphs: GOLDY has been operating for more than three decades, owns its design and planning, and already offers wholesale, OEM, retail and pop-up formats. For a distributor or retailer in Asia, this means a Tokyo-based supplier that can discuss assortment, display and short-term retail events directly.
The introduction is handled through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), which screens inquiries before passing them to the company.
